Channel ID, which can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.), with a maximum length of 36 characters.
Channel title, supporting Chinese and English, with a maximum length of 32 characters.
Channel announcement, supporting Chinese and English, with a maximum length of 256 characters.
The channel owner ID, which supports only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 36 characters.
Extension fields, passed as needed, for additional channel properties to be recorded.

UpdateShareScreenLayout.summary: Invoke UpdateShareScreenLayout to update the shared screen layout. This can be used in classroom scenarios to overlay the teacher's camera feed on the shared screen within the live stream.

schema.description: Unique identifier of the application, consisting of 6 lowercase letters or digits.
Unique identifier of the classroom, returned by the CreateClass call.
Whether to enable overlaying the teacher's camera feed
X coordinate of the overlay, with the origin at the top-left corner, normalized to 1
Y coordinate of the overlay, with the origin at the top-left corner, normalized to 1
Width of the overlay, normalized to 1
Height of the overlay, normalized to 1
